description: Energy explores where our energy comes from and how it is converted and used: everyday devices, building a system that converts energy, efficiency and waste, tracking your household’s use, national energy sources, and the future of energy systems.
outlineNote: Excerpts showed the topics (how devices convert energy, building a system with energy conversions, efficiency, a household energy log, energy waste, U.S. energy sources and use, and improving energy systems) but not their numbering, so no requirement outline is published yet.
